info.name: MongoDB Atlas Administration Access Tracking Collection Level Metrics API

params.name: groupId
params.description:
Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access.

**NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether Application wraps the response in an `envelope` JSON object. Some API clients cannot access the HTTP response headers or status code. To remediate this, set envelope=true in the query. Endpoints that return a list of results use the results object as an envelope. Application adds the status parameter to the response body.

params.name: clusterName
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the cluster to retrieve pinned namespaces for.

items.docs: Returns a list of given cluster's pinned namespaces, a set of namespaces manually selected by users to collect query latency metrics on.

params.name: groupId

params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the cluster to pin namespaces to.

params.name: clusterView
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the cluster topology to retrieve metrics for.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether Application wraps the response in an `envelope` JSON object. Some API clients cannot access the HTTP response headers or status code. To remediate this, set envelope=true in the query. Endpoints that return a list of results use the results object as an envelope. Application adds the status parameter to the response body.

params.name: start
params.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud begins reporting the metrics. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. Include this parameter when you do not set **period**.

params.name: end
params.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud stops reporting the metrics. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. Include this parameter when you do not set **period**.

params.name: period
params.description: Duration over which Atlas reports the metrics. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 duration format in UTC. Include this parameter when you do not set **start** and **end**.

items.docs: Return the subset of namespaces from the given cluster sorted by highest total execution time (descending) within the given time window.

info.name: Return Ranked Namespaces from One Host

params.name: groupId
params.description:
Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access.

**NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups.

params.name: processId
params.description: Combination of hostname and IANA port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, fully qualified domain name (FQDN), or Internet Protocol address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the host that runs the MongoDB process (mongod or mongos). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests.
